dimensions.name: CONTEXT
dimensions.comment: What the article says about the player: injury, lineup, transaction, suspension, or other.

dimensions.name: DETAIL
dimensions.comment: One-sentence extracted detail about the player, as reported. Quote or paraphrase with the source and time.

dimensions.name: FEED
dimensions.comment: Source feed: pft (ProFootballTalk), pfr (Pro Football Rumors), cbs, espn, or club_<abbr> for a team site.

dimensions.name: PLAYER_NAME_TEXT
dimensions.comment: Player name exactly as the article wrote it. Use when full_name is NULL.

dimensions.name: PUBLISHED_AT
dimensions.comment: When the article was published: the outlet timestamp, else the feed timestamp, else fetch time.

dimensions.name: RESOLUTION_METHOD
dimensions.comment: How the name was matched to a roster player.

dimensions.name: FULL_NAME
dimensions.comment: Resolved player full name. NULL when the mention did not resolve to a roster player.

dimensions.name: TEAM_FULL_NAME
dimensions.comment: Team the article names for this mention, when recognized.

facts.name: CANDIDATE_COUNT
facts.comment: Roster players sharing the mentioned name. Above 1 means the team named in the article decided the match.
